note: How much cheaper the search can be made without losing measurable strength, replayed from the exp023 reference dumps (n=12,693 held-out decisions, all with pruned moves discarded). Differences are paired against the first row.

settings.label: and no search in pure races

caveat: These are WIDTH savings at one ply. Depth is not free: one ply of search is worth 0.26 to 0.74 PR depending on position type, so trimming depth does cost strength. Untested: whether depth itself can be reduced anywhere without loss.
